chunks: What Mūsā ibn al-Qāsim narrated from ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar, from his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about the skins of the sacrificial animals: is it permissible for the one who offered them as sacrifice to make them into a sack? He said: It is not permissible for him to make them into a sack unless he gives its price in charity.

key_terms.الْأَضَاحِيِّ: the sacrificial animals offered as uḍḥiyah
key_terms.بِثَمَنِهَا: with its price or monetary value
key_terms.جُلُودِ: the hides or skins of the sacrificed animals
key_terms.جِرَابًا: a sack or leather bag made from skin

ai.seo_question: Can the hide of a sacrificial animal be used for personal benefit after slaughter?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the hides of sacrificial animals. It states that the person who offered the sacrifice should not use the hide for personal benefit, such as making it into a sack, unless he gives its value in charity.
